Control Dyson air purifiers, fans, and heaters via local MQTT. Use when asked to control Dyson devices, adjust fan speed, set temperature/heat, enable oscillation, or check room temperature/humidity. Requires being on the same WiFi network.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release. Lets clawd control your Dyson purifiers, fans, and heaters.
- Local MQTT control after one-time setup
- Setup flow to fetch device credentials via Dyson account
- Device management: list devices, set default, remove, and check connectivity
- Full controls: power, fan speed/auto, oscillation angles, heat mode/target temp, night mode
- Status output with air quality and environmental readings, plus JSON output for scripting
